recognize_zh: 骨髓切片高倍下細胞密集，可見成群的紅血球系前驅細胞，核圓、染色質細緻偏開放（megaloblastoid），另有散在的顆粒球與紅色嗜酸性顆粒細胞；紅血球系增生且核質成熟不同步，是 MDS 多系發育不良在切片上的表現。
features: Hypercellular marrow with clusters of erythroid precursors
Erythroid precursors with round nuclei, finely dispersed to open chromatin and moderate cytoplasm, suggestive of megaloblastoid change
Scattered mature and band neutrophils and occasional eosinophils
Few larger cells with prominent nucleoli but no sheets of blasts
Interstitial hemorrhage/red cells between hematopoietic cells
describe_en: High-power H&E section of the bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with prominent clusters of erythroid precursors displaying round nuclei with relatively open chromatin, suggestive of megaloblastoid maturation. Granulocytic elements, including segmented neutrophils and occasional eosinophils, are admixed. Sheets of blasts are not seen, and megakaryocytes are not well represented in this field. The findings support erythroid hyperplasia with possible dyserythropoiesis, compatible with a myelodysplastic neoplasm such as MDS with ring sideroblasts and multilineage dysplasia; aspirate morphology and iron stain are required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic anemia shows giant metamyelocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils with correction after vitamin replacement, whereas MDS persists and shows ring sideroblasts/clonal abnormalities.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of immature proerythroblasts (≥80% erythroid, ≥30% proerythroblasts), unlike the maturing clusters here.
Reactive hyperplasia shows orderly maturation without multilineage dysplasia or ring sideroblasts.
